learning_outcomes.text: Explain the basics of manufacturing and properties of the most important fiber and matrix materials.
Distinguish the essential processing methods for fiber-reinforced plastics.
Manufacture and test fiber-reinforced plastics in theory and practice.
Make a preliminary selection of processes based on requirement profiles for fiber-reinforced components.
Manufacture plates and simple prototype components using hand lamination and resin infusion processes.
Calculate the number of fiber layers and rovings for a given layer thickness, as well as fiber volume fractions.
Calculate the mechanical properties (engineering constants) for individual layers.

Make a preliminary selection of suitable fiber/matrix combinations and processing methods for a component with a known requirement profile. This includes distinguishing from competing processes such as injection molding of short and long fiber-reinforced plastics, which are not part of this module.
Apply the theoretically learned knowledge practically within the framework of the internship.
Select the correct combination of fiber and matrix together with the optimal processing method for components from industrial practice.
Estimate the advantages and disadvantages of methods already known from other modules (e.g., plastics processing) compared to the newly learned methods.
Produce fiber-reinforced plastic plates in groups during the internship and write a joint report. They must solve tasks together, discuss and reflect on results, and summarize them in a report.

syllabus_topics: Manufacturing and properties of matrix materials
Manufacturing, properties and presentation of fiber materials
Fundamentals of design and dimensioning of fiber-reinforced plastics
Planning of manufacturing and calculation of a laminate structure
Manufacturing of various laminate structures using hand lamination and resin infusion processes
Experimental determination of fiber volume content and mechanical properties
Comparison of calculation results with measured mechanical properties
assessment_rules: The choice between an oral examination or a written exam is at the discretion of the examiner and will be announced at the beginning of the semester. The graded assessment is either an oral examination (duration according to the valid general examination regulations) or a written exam (duration according to the valid study regulations). An ungraded experimental work involving approximately 5-10 experiments is also required.
